sentences.text:
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 252/2022, registered at Police Station Jhallar,
District-Betul (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code and Section 5(L) r/w 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and falsely being implicated in the case.
It is submitted that prosecutrix is about 18 years of age.
She was consenting party.
Applicant is in jail since 25.08.2022.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
It is submitted by him that prosecutrix is minor and her consent is immaterial.

In view of same,
application be dismissed.

sentences.text: Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Prosecutrix is more than 17 years of age.
She was consenting party.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
6. Considering aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.

8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
9. C.C as per rules.
